$comment: Sim Lab part metadata v2 (docs/SIM-LAB-PLAN.md B3a; PartMeta v2 in bw-sim/contracts.js, docs/ROBOT-LAB-ARCHITECTURE.md §5.4: a motor or sensor names its device, whose numbers are in bw-sim/devices/catalog.js). Authored by hand for this project from the official LDraw geometry, measured with bw-sim/ldraw/ldraw-geometry.js; never copied from BrickLink Studio, LDCad or any other connectivity database (plan D4). LDraw frame and units (LDU, -y up). test/bw-sim-part-meta.test.mjs checks every connector against the part mesh. Masses are estimates to +-20% (no published per-part masses); motor torque is LEGO's published stall torque for the medium angular motor (18 Ncm) and speed is the SPIKE 3 velocity limit used by docs/SPIKE-ARENA.md. Entries marked "derived": true are not measured by hand: scripts/derive-part-meta.mjs derives them from their LDraw files (connection primitives, measured anti-stud cells; mass = mesh volume x ABS 1.05 g/cm3; nameDeGenerated: a generated German name), and admits one only when it passes the geometry contract.
$references: LDraw assemblies vendored only so the metadata test can check a connector against LDraw's own placement (39370c01: where the castor ball sits in its socket). 41769.dat is LDraw's `~Moved to 41769a` alias, vendored only so test/bw-sim-canonical-frame.test.mjs checks that an alias is found as a duplicate by its geometry (part-meta/canonical-frame.js). 65414c01.dat is LDraw's assembly of the differential 65414 with its cover 65413 and satellites 6589: scripts/derive-part-meta.mjs reads where the satellites and the cover sit (the casing's gear-seat and snap connectors). 92693c01-f1/-f2.dat are LDraw's contracted and extended small linear actuator: the stroke and the spindle's thread are derived from them (scripts/derive-part-meta.mjs deriveLinearActuator) and test/bw-sim-linear-actuator.test.mjs checks them against them.
